what: The refusal record of 2026-09-27T01:01:49Z was written by the collector as it stood before 2026-09-27 02:14 UTC. Three of its fields are mislabelled by that version and are kept unchanged, because the record is the evidence that the defect existed.

mislabelled_fields.revert_selector: 0x9240a35a is NOT a function selector. It is the first four bytes of 0x9240a35a7f8192388a0d9fcb799ad679d974de183d25caa9a8b034dbf4b107df, the stateRoot of block 73530638 -- the block this round was pinned at. The collector searched the error message (prose) for the first 0x and reported ten characters of it as a selector.
mislabelled_fields.revert_selectors: Same value, same reason. Read `kinds` instead on records written after 2026-09-27 02:14 UTC; this record predates that field.
mislabelled_fields.revert_data: Not revert data. It is the tail of the error message, prose included ("] layer stale\nmissing trie node ..."). revert_data_bytes 91 counts characters of that prose, not bytes of ABI.

actual_cause: The endpoint could not serve the pinned block's state: "missing trie node ... layer stale". A state-pruning error on the public endpoint, not a revert and not a property of the pool. The full message is preserved verbatim in error.message (185 characters).

verify_without_a_key.note: Block headers are never pruned; only state is. The public endpoint answers this.

fixed_in_collector: From 2026-09-27 02:14 UTC revert_selector is taken from error.data only, never from error.message; `kind` is one of state_unavailable / rate_limited / revert / rpc; state_unavailable is retried. Records written after that time carry `kinds`.
